english_translation: My head is aching severely during my pregnancy and is not getting better; what medicine can I safely take?
grammar_notes: Concordial Agreement (Zvivakashure): Notice how 'ndakazvitakura' establishes the noun class/subject frame (1st Person Sg Past Concord (ndaka-)).
Agglutinative Morphology: 'akanyanyisa' combines prefixal/suffixal morphemes (a- (Cl. 1 subj) + -ka- (remote past) + -nyanyisa (stem)) with tone contour H-L-H-L.
Penultimate Lengthening: In Zezuru declarative sentences, the second-to-last syllable of the phrase carries natural vowel lengthening.
cultural_notes: In Harare Zezuru standard speech, speakers maintain strict alliterative concord (zvivakashure) across noun classes while using respectful plural forms (hunhu).

active_exercises.prompt: Complete the Zezuru sentence: 'ndakazvitakura asi musoro wangu wanga uchinyanyotema zvakanyanya hausikuda kunyarara, hausi kuda kupera musoro wangu kutema kwacho marwadzo acho ______' (My head is aching severely during my pregnancy and is not getting better; what medicine can I safely take?)
active_exercises.explanation: 'akanyanyisa' completes the clause with the proper Zezuru lexical and tonal pattern.

active_exercises.prompt: Which Zezuru noun class or concord (chivakashure) governs 'ndakazvitakura' in 'ndakazvitakura asi musoro wangu wanga uchinyanyotema zvakanyanya hausikuda kunyarara, hausi kuda kupera musoro wangu kutema kwacho marwadzo acho akanyanyisa'?
active_exercises.explanation: 'ndakazvitakura' operates under 1st Person Sg Past Concord (ndaka-) in Central Shona (Harare standard).
